title: REAR COMPT LAMP, TAIL & LICENSE LAMP MONITOR
summary: Rear storage compartment lamp (behind-the-seat courtesy lamp) and the tail & license lamp monitor leads (fiber-optic lamp monitor in the console), all models. The compartment lamp screws to the rear compartment lamp bracket (see UPC 1) and its wire is taped to the underbody; the lamp monitor lead, part of the rear body harness, runs forward along the floor in riveted clips to a bracket under the console trim plate that is held by a screw.
